verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at developers.circle.com (HTTP 200, with a structured platform summary). The cited doc pages are served as markdown (.md URLs), which agents can read directly. Circle also documents an MCP server built to help LLMs and AI IDEs generate and fix code against its Wallets, Contracts, CCTP and Gateway products. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent actually consuming these docs effectively, and verification of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g., whether a full-content variant exists).
